host_in_current_sqm.description: Current SQM readout on HostIn receive lane <lane>; a U8 value of s encodes the SQM value 10 + s/10. Mirrored ingress-management register (visibility only); the overview table records RW Adv. access.

host_in_sqm_alarm_ind.description: SQM degraded alarm indicator: 0: no SQM degraded alarm latched since last read, 1: SQM degraded alarm latched since last read. Mirrored ingress-management register (visibility only).

mod_hsout_amplitude.description: Encoded differential peak-peak amplitude at TP1a for ModHsOut lane <lane>; shared-memory in/out parameter of the amplitude setting and tuning procedures.

mod_hsout_amplitude_tune.description: Amplitude tuning instruction requested for ModHsOut lane <lane>; default step size 50 mV; value 3 sets the amplitude given in ModHsOut<lane>Amplitude.

mod_hsout_ffe_tap_1.description: SM8-encoded FFE tap 1 value for ModHsOut lane <lane>: sign in bit 7 (0 positive, 1 negative), magnitude 0..127 in bits 6-0 with 0.01 per LSB, i.e. a tap value range of -1.27 to +1.27. Shared-memory in/out parameter; when advertised, the module keeps the register current under tuning operations and preset loading.

mod_hsout_ffe_tap_1_saturated.description: Indicates that the tap value limit was reached on FFE tap 1 of ModHsOut lane <lane> during an increment/decrement tuning request; the request fails and leaves the tap value unchanged.

mod_hsout_ffe_tap_1_tune.description: Tuning instruction for FFE tap 1 of ModHsOut lane <lane>, inside the atomically updated U16 per-lane tuning register at bytes 196-211; instructions for unused taps are ignored. Default step size 0.02.

mod_hsout_invoke_tuning_trig.description: Host indicates a Tuning Request Raised (TRR) for lane <lane>; the module clears the bit when it reads (self-clearing). 0: no tuning request, 1: tuning request for lane <lane>. H2M message bit.

mod_hsout_output_saturated.description: Indicates that the output amplitude of ModHsOut lane <lane> saturated at the minimum or maximum amplitude during an adjustment request; a permanent status indication.

mod_hsout_training_done_ind.description: Indicator after completion of ingress training: 0: ingress training not started or not yet completed, 1: ingress training completed, examine training status and result. Visibility-only register, not relevant for the module (see namespace README for the overview/table ordering note).

mod_hsout_tuning_completed_flag.description: Module indicates tuning procedure completion for lane <lane>: 0: no tuning requested or not yet completed, 1: requested operation completed. M2H message bit, clear on read.

mod_hsout_tuning_type.description: Type of tuning requested for lane <lane> when the tuning procedure is invoked: 0: FFE tap tuning (Table 68), 1: output amplitude tuning (Table 69).
